cases.description: The owner's exported Riven deck (39 main + champion, 12 runes 7 Chaos + 5 Calm, 3 battlefields, sideboard 10) is legal in 1v1 with no bans.
The same deck is legal in 2v2 with no bans.
A 2v2 ban keyed with a typographic apostrophe matches the card "Zhonya's Hourglass".
A card banned only in 2v2 does not make the deck illegal in 1v1.
A banned card in the sideboard makes the deck illegal.
A ban by name covers every printing (two spellings of one name_key); the issue is reported once, with the name of the first printing in zone order.
A banned card only in the workbench is ignored.
Bans apply to the legend, the champion, battlefields and runes as well.
An empty v2 deck reports every missing part.
Without a legend no identity is checked: off-colour cards, runes and the champion tag are not reported.
A deck without a chosen champion.
The chosen champion must share a tag with the legend; its colour is not checked.
A card without the Champion supertype in the champion slot is off identity (no champion_tag reported on top).
A main deck of 38 cards (the champion is not counted).
A main deck of 40 cards is over the size.
11 runes.
13 runes (also a hard limit).
A rune whose colour is not one of the legend's domains; the count is still 12.
A card that is not a rune in the rune pool.
Two battlefields.
Four battlefields (also a hard limit).
Two printings of the same battlefield name are a duplicate.
A card that is not a battlefield.
Sideboard of 11 cards (also a hard limit).
An empty sideboard is missing 10 cards (soft).
A sideboard of 9 is missing 1 card (soft).
(a) Three copies spread over three printings of one name are legal.
(a) Four copies over printings of one name are over the limit.
(b) The chosen champion takes one of the three copies of its name.
(b) Two more copies of the champion in the main deck are legal.
The workbench counts for the copy limit (prototype bug L9 fixed).
Main and sideboard copies add up (the real deck keeps Reckless Innovator at 2 + 1).

Names are matched by name_key (case folded, typographic apostrophe, whitespace runs) and same-code issues are ordered by case-folded code points: "aegis of dawn" < "battle preparations" < "zhonya's hourglass" < "élan vital" (an accent sorts after z, unlike localeCompare). "Not So Fast" + "Not  So fast" is 2 copies: legal.
100 distinct names in the workbench.
101 distinct names in the workbench.
The workbench is out of legality: off-colour cards, tokens and legends there are fine.
A main-deck card whose colour is not one of the legend's domains.
A two-domain card needs both domains in the identity (Fury + Calm under Chaos/Calm).
A Signature card must share a tag with the legend even when its colour fits.
Legends, battlefields and runes never go in the main deck or the sideboard.
The chosen champion must be a Champion Unit: a Champion Gear is off identity (type).
A battlefield in the main deck, a legend and a rune in the sideboard: wrong types are soft issues (reason type), counted in the zone sizes.
A partly loaded deck (owner, 2026-11-04: it must load even when cards are missing): each section says how many cards it is missing.
A card that is not a Legend in the legend slot is off identity (zone legend); its domains and tags still act as the identity (Chaos; the Riven signature fits).
A Colorless-only legend has no colours: every coloured card and rune is off identity.
Tokens ("Token Unit", a bare "Token", "Token Battlefield") are never part of a deck; they get token_in_deck, not card_off_identity.
A token in the champion slot.
Issues come in code order (legend_missing … banned), then by name, then zone.
(a) A third copy through another printing of the name is allowed.
(a) A fourth copy is refused even through another printing.
(b) With the champion chosen, a third main-deck copy of its name is refused.
(f) A workbench copy is refused when main + sideboard + champion already hold 3.
(e) The 10th sideboard card is allowed.
(e) The 11th sideboard card is refused.
Identity is a soft rule: an off-colour card can be added (validate reports it).
The main deck size is soft: a 40th card is allowed.
A legend never goes in the main deck.
A rune never goes in the main deck.
A battlefield never goes in the main deck.
A legend never goes in the sideboard.
A rune never goes in the sideboard.
A Champion Unit can go in the main deck.
A battlefield never goes in the sideboard.
A token is refused outside the workbench.
A token can go in the workbench.
(g) The 12th rune is allowed.
(g) The 13th rune is refused.
(g) A rune outside the legend's colours is refused.
No runes without a legend.
Only runes go in the rune pool.
(h) The third distinct battlefield is allowed.
(h) A fourth battlefield is refused.
(h) Another printing of a chosen battlefield is a duplicate.
Only battlefields go in the battlefields.
A 101st distinct name in the workbench is refused.
A full workbench still takes another copy of a name it already holds.
The 100th distinct name in the workbench is allowed.
(f) Moving workbench → main is refused when main + sideboard + champion already hold 3 (prototype rule, kept).
Moving workbench → main with 2 in the deck is allowed.
Moving into a full sideboard is refused.
Moving into a sideboard of 9 is allowed.
Moving keeps the copy count: sideboard → main is fine.
Moving a new name into a workbench of 100 names is refused.
Moving a copy into the workbench.
A token cannot leave the workbench.
A legend in the workbench cannot go to the sideboard.
Demand Chaos 5 / Calm 19: 2.5 → 3 and 9.5 → 10 (floor(x + 0.5), not banker's rounding), sum 13, the largest loses one → 3 / 9.
One colour gets the 12 runes.
One colour and no cards: 12.
Two colours and no coloured card (Colorless does not count): 6 / 6; every previous rune is replaced.
Demand 2 / 2 / 3: 3.43 → 3, 3, 5.14 → 5, sum 11; the colours ordered by runes desc (stable: Mind, Fury, Calm) get +1 in turn → 3 / 3 / 6, output in legend domain order.
A Fury/Chaos card counts for both colours: Fury 6 / Chaos 3 → 8 / 4.
The chosen champion counts one copy: Chaos 1 (champion) / Calm 1 → 6 / 6.
The sideboard, the legend and the current runes do not count: Chaos 0 / Calm 2 → max(1, 0) = 1 / 12, sum 13 → 1 / 11.
The rune printing already in the deck for a colour is kept (SFD Chaos Rune); output in legend domain order.
Without a rune of the colour in the deck, the first rune of that colour in catalog order is used (here SFD before OGN for Chaos).
Without a legend nothing changes.
A legend with no colours changes nothing.
A colour with no rune card in the catalog is skipped; the others share the 12.
The owner's deck: Chaos 16 + champion = 17 / Calm 19 → 5.67 → 6 and 6.33 → 6.
(d) Changing the legend to Jinx (Fury/Chaos) purges the Calm runes and the Riven champion; the main deck and the sideboard are untouched.
Another printing of the same legend keeps runes and champion.
The champion is kept when it shares any tag with the new legend (region tag "Zaun").
Removing the legend purges every rune and the champion.
Only a Legend can be the legend.
A token cannot be the legend.
Setting the first legend keeps the champion that shares a tag and the runes of its colours.
Choosing a champion that shares a tag with the legend.
(c) Choosing a champion whose name already has 3 copies removes one from the main deck, from the printing with the most copies.
(c) With none in the main deck the copy comes out of the sideboard (before the workbench).
(c) Last the workbench; the printing with the most copies loses one.
(c) A line that reaches 0 copies is removed from its zone.
Replacing the champion by another printing: the old champion no longer counts, so 2 main copies + the new champion = 3 and nothing is removed.
A champion without a tag in common is refused.
No champion without a legend.
Only a Champion card can be the chosen champion.
A Champion card that is not a Unit is refused.
A token cannot be the champion.
Removing the champion.
The owner's deck: Calm and Chaos, in DOMAINS order.
Legend + champion + main only (not sideboard, runes, battlefields, workbench); Colorless excluded.
A domain unknown to DOMAINS comes after the known.
An empty deck has no domains.
The owner's deck breaks no hard limit.
Sizes not reached, a 42-card main, off identity, duplicates and no legend are not hard limits.
3 copies over printings and zones is the maximum.
A 4th copy (workbench included) breaks the copy limit.
The champion + 3 copies breaks the copy limit.
Sideboard 10 is the maximum.
Sideboard 11.
12 runes is the maximum.
13 runes.
3 battlefields is the maximum.
4 battlefields.
100 distinct workbench names is the maximum.
101 distinct workbench names.
Tokens in the workbench are fine.
A token in any other zone breaks the token rule, once per name, ordered by name.
Violations come in rule order: copies (by name), sideboard, workbench, battlefields, runes, token (by name).

D-F5-7: names sort by name_key (case folded, typographic apostrophes as ', whitespace runs as one space) in code-point order, ties by the raw name in code-point order. Space < apostrophe < comma; accented capitals sort after z; "REBUKE" < "Rebuke".
Whitespace runs and case do not change the order key; equal keys fall back to the raw name.
